_readme: C3-A stall zones — per-camera quadrilaterals over the STOREFRONT head-on row
(56-space row against the long building; operator scope pick A, classifier 1).
Coordinates are NATIVE camera pixels (2688x1520 for the suite-* cams).
quad order: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left (ground area of
the stall where a parked vehicle body sits — NOT the painted lines).
ids are CAMERA-LOCAL (cam-s#) until the physical stall mapping (1..56 along
the row) is established from overlap analysis; keep ids stable once classified.
Author zones against a gridded frame: python tools/c3-stalls.py --grid <camera>.
